description: This file is a PHP script that generates a web page for changing an administrator password. It includes security measures like CSRF protection, session validation, and client-side validation for the password change form. The page contains JavaScript for form handling, validation, and UI interactions.

methods.name: next_step
methods.description: Handles the process of validating and submitting the password change request via AJAX.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends the new password configuration to the server and handles the response.

methods.name: cancel_save
methods.description: Redirects the user to the 'at_a_glance.php' page when canceling the password change.
